# Modifier reference

> Platform-neutral visual + interaction modifiers applied to any component (`node.modifiers`). A closed set — an unknown key fails validation.

| Prop | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|:--:|---|
| `padding` | `EdgeInsets` |  |  |
| `background` | `Color` |  |  |
| `material` | `ultraThin` · `thin` · `regular` · `thick` · `bar` · `glass` |  | Translucent system material behind the node. 'ultraThin'…'thick' are the four native blur tiers, 'bar' matches the toolbar material, and 'glass' is the visionOS-style frosted pane (material + hairline gradient stroke). Renders natively on iOS/Android/Aurora. |
| `blur` | `number` |  | Gaussian blur radius (points) applied to the node itself — distinct from 'material', which frosts what is behind the node. e.g. a blurred hero image behind a sheet. 0 = no blur. |
| `cornerRadius` | `Dimension` |  |  |
| `opacity` | `number` |  |  |
| `scale` | `number` \| `string` |  | Uniform scale — a number or a $state binding. Pair with animation for a spring scale on state change. |
| `rotation` | `number` \| `string` |  | Rotation in degrees — a constant or a $state binding. Pairs with 'animation' for a spinning / flipping element. |
| `pulse` | `string` \| object |  | A rhythmic auto-reversing scale 'heartbeat' — a bool $state key (pulses while true) or an object { while, scale, interval }. e.g. album art beating to music, or a live dot. |
| `zoomable` | `boolean` |  | Make the element interactively pinch-to-zoom, two-finger-rotate and drag, double-tap to reset — a photo-viewer gesture from one flag. |
| `presentWhen` | `string` |  | Present this subtree as a modal when the given bool $state key is true. It shares the screen's state, so a filter sheet drives the same list. |
| `presentStyle` | `fullScreen` · `sheet` |  | How a 'presentWhen' subtree is presented. |
| `ignoresSafeArea` | `boolean` |  | Extend this node under the safe area (edge-to-edge) — for immersive backgrounds. |
| `frame` | object |  |  |
| `size` | object |  | Explicit, platform-neutral sizing per axis. Prefer this over 'frame' — it lays out identically on iOS and Android instead of relying on platform defaults. |
| `accessibility` | object |  | Accessibility metadata. Explicit because a control read as a button by VoiceOver is not automatically labelled for TalkBack. |
| `shadow` | object |  |  |
| `onTap` | `Action` |  | Tap gesture on the whole component. |
| `onDoubleTap` | `Action` |  | Double-tap gesture on the whole component (e.g. like-to-favourite). |
| `hitSlop` | `number` |  | Extra invisible tap padding (points) so small controls stay comfortably tappable. |
| `onLongPress` | `Action` |  | Long-press gesture; commonly opens a context menu. |
| `contextMenu` | object[] |  | Menu items shown on long-press. |
| `swipe` | object |  | Swipe-to-reveal actions. 'leading' reveals on a left-to-right swipe, 'trailing' on a right-to-left swipe. |
| `animation` | object |  | Animation applied when this node's inputs change. |
